extraction.Name: Julia Irving Mesteth
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment of 160, but the Indian Agency told her that she would have to accept it, so she did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1920, she sold her land to Louis Larvie, of Martin, South Dakota, for $1600.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: Louis Larvie, of Martin, South Dakota, for $1600.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she paid her taxes, which were delinquent
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her children are supported by her husband, who works for the Holy Rosary Mission School
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and has good health; mother of two minor children who have good health; has never received any help from the County or Government; document sworn November 17, 1928
